---
title: "wrapped fixture: CSS function widths"
filters:
  - wrapped
format: html
---

Each value in the first part reaches the style as written. Each width in the second part is zero, negative, or not finite at every size, each gap in the third part is negative or not finite at every size, and each value in the fourth part is one the filter does not read as a length; these print a warning, and the value takes its default.
